newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down and nine-month, 12-month T-bills yields rose from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills edged down to 21.11 percent from 22.27 percent, six-month bills slipped to 23.58 percent from 23.98 percent, nine-month bills firmed to 28.83 percent from 28.71 percent and 12-month bills firmed to 32.91 percent from 32.45 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 6.40 million UAH
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 6.40 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.75 million UAH 6.06 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 21.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.83 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.01 million UAH 8.93 million UAH
The central bank sold 78,342 T-bills, the bank statement said. Of those, 13,150 were competitive and 65,192 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 21.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 30.00 million UAH 25.50 million UAH
Amount sold 10.89 million UAH 15.18 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.96 million UAH 12.50 million UAH
The central bank sold 108,879 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 94,293 were competitive and 14,586 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 21.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 37.00 million UAH 32.00 million UAH
Amount sold 29.89 million UAH 25.14 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.50 million UAH 18.99 million UAH
The central bank sold 298,896 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 155,113 were competitive and 143,783 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 21.
